title: [master]Subscription Billing: O(N²) contract-renewal detection in Sales-Post subscribers slows posting (~28% of batch CPU)
summary: Contract renewal detection in the Subscription Billing Sales-Post subscribers was reworked to remove O(N²) behavior. Before the fix, this check took about 28% of batch posting CPU.
key_points: Contract renewal detection in the Sales-Post subscribers no longer scales quadratically
The old check took about 28% of batch posting CPU
The change is limited to codeunit 8001 Sub. Contr. Renewal Subcribers
Intended to speed up sales posting when Subscription Billing is used
